sources.label: Grow a Garden Wiki - Gear Shop

items.name: Watering Can
items.use: Speeds up crop growth.

items.name: Trowel
items.use: Realign crops.

items.name: Trading Ticket
items.use: Allows trading with other players.

items.name: Recall Wrench
items.use: Teleports the user to the Gear Shop.

items.name: Basic Sprinkler
items.use: Increases growth speed and harvest size of crops within its radius.

items.name: Firework
items.use: Launches a firework into the sky.

items.name: Charcoal Sprinkler
items.use: Can apply the Charcoal mutation.

items.name: Advanced Sprinkler
items.use: Increases growth speed and mutation chance of crops within its radius.

items.name: Medium Treat
items.use: Used on pets for a medium XP boost over time (lasts 1 day).

items.name: Medium Toy
items.use: Gives a pet a medium boost (8–9%) to their passive ability for 5 minutes.

items.name: Night Staff
items.use: Guarantees the moonlit mutation of 6 random plants in the user's garden.

items.name: Star Caller
items.use: Redirects shooting stars to land in its close vicinity.

items.name: Garden Guide
items.price: Free (used to be obtained upon joining the game)
items.use: Used to look up information about Daily Quests, Achievements, Crops, Pets, Cosmetics, Food, and Mutations.

items.name: Godly Sprinkler
items.use: Increases growth speed, mutation chance, and harvest size of crops within its radius.

items.name: Chocolate Sprinkler
items.use: Multi-harvest fruit within its area are covered in chocolate.

items.name: Magnifying Glass
items.use: Inspects plants to reveal their value and growth progress (updates dynamically).

items.name: Nectar Staff
items.use: Attracts more bees to pollinate the player's fruit.

items.name: Pollen Radar
items.use: Scans and collects nearby pollinated fruit.

items.name: Silver Fertilizer
items.use: Makes a plant silver for 2 hours.

items.name: Lush Sprinkler
items.use: Turns nearby plants Lush. Lasts 1 minute.

items.name: Geode Sprinkler
items.use: Turns nearby plants Geode. Lasts 1 minute.

items.name: Master Sprinkler
items.use: Greatly increases growth speed, mutation chance, and harvest size of crops within its radius.

items.name: Cleaning Spray
items.use: Removes all mutations from the selected crop.

items.name: Favorite Tool
items.use: Prevents selected crops from being picked up by the user.

items.name: Harvest Tool
items.use: Harvests all fruit from the selected plant.

items.name: Friendship Pot
items.use: A flower pot to share with a friend.

items.name: Honey Sprinkler
items.use: Applies the Honey Glazed mutation to crops within its radius.

items.name: Pet Mutation Shard Tranquil
items.use: Applies the Tranquil mutation to a pet.

items.name: Pet Mutation Shard Corrupted
items.use: Applies the Corrupted mutation to a pet.

items.name: Maple Sprinkler
items.use: Increases growth speed, mutation chances, and fruit size of fall plants (lasts 5 minutes).

items.name: Large Toy
items.price: Trader Rewards Watering Can Advertisement Forever Pack Rare Present Gold Gift Rainbow Gift
items.use: Gives a pet a large boost to their passive ability for 5 minutes.

items.name: Smith Treat
items.use: Used on pets for a large XP boost over time (lasts 1 day).

items.name: Gold Fertilizer
items.use: Makes a plant gold for 2 hours.

items.name: Rainbow Fertilizer
items.use: Makes a plant rainbow for 2 hours.

items.name: Pet Pouch
items.use: Increases your pet inventory slots by +1. Max +50.

items.name: Levelup Lollipop
items.use: Increases chosen pet age by 1.

items.name: Grandmaster Sprinkler
items.use: Massively increases growth speed, mutation chances, fruit size, and boosts pets.

items.name: Rainbow Lollipop
items.use: Increases chosen pet age by 50.

items.name: Silver Lollipop
items.use: Increases chosen pet age by 5.

items.name: Gold Lollipop
items.use: Increases chosen pet age by 10.

items.name: Mega Lollipop
items.use: Increases chosen pet age by 100.

items.name: Lightning Rod
items.price: 1× Basic Sprinkler + 1× Advanced Sprinkler + 1× Godly Sprinkler + 500,000 179
items.use: Redirects lightning from its vicinity to a chosen point in the user's garden.

items.name: Tanning Mirror
items.price: 1× Basic Sprinkler + 1× Advanced Sprinkler + 1× Godly Sprinkler + 500,000 219
items.use: Attracts sun rays to nearby crops.

items.name: Reclaimer
items.use: Reclaims plants, turning them into seeds (3 uses).

items.name: Small Toy
items.use: Gives a pet a small passive ability boost (3 uses).

items.name: Small Treat
items.price: 1× Common Egg + 1× Dragon Fruit Seed + 1× Blueberry + 1,000,000 89
items.use: Gives a pet a small XP boost over time (3 uses).

items.name: Smith Hammer of Harvest
items.use: Harvests all fruit within a radius.

items.name: Smith Treat
items.price: 1× Common Coal + 1× Rare Coal + 2× Small Treat + 4,000,000 229
items.use: Used on pets for a large XP boost over time.

items.name: Pet Pouch
items.price: 1× Common Egg + 1× Corndog + 1× Small Treat + 1× Small Toy + 50,000,000 89
items.use: Increases your pet inventory slots by +1. Max +50.

items.name: Pet Mutation Shard Giantbean
items.use: Applies the GiantBean mutation on a pet: 15% faster hunger rate + ~0.12 xp/s per Beanstalk planted.

items.name: Chimera Stone
items.price: 1× Mythical Egg + 1× Bug Egg + 1× Jungle Egg + 1× Gem Egg + 500,000,000 199
items.use: Use the Stone to fuse the Chimera with the required pets and cosmetics.

items.name: Thundelbringer
items.price: 1× Smith Hammer of Harvest + 1× Lightning Rod + 1× Legendary Coal + 1× Divine Coal + 40,000,000 489

items.use: Greatly increases size bonus for Grapes, Blueberries, Strawberries, Raspberries, and Celestiberries (1.5 min duration).
